description: This file defines the FavoritesController class which manages favorite records in the SuiteCRM application. It handles actions such as creating, removing, checking, and retrieving favorites for the current user.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller class for managing user's favorite records, extending the SugarController framework.

methods.name: action_create_record
methods.description: Creates a new favorite record for the current user based on request parameters and outputs the new favorite ID.

methods.name: action_remove_record
methods.description: Removes a favorite record for the current user if it exists, based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_check_favorite
methods.description: Checks if a favorite exists for a specific record module and record ID, returning the favorite ID or false.

methods.name: action_get_sidebar_elements
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's favorite records for display in the sidebar.
